description: Main source code for sensor data processing and trigger handling for the ICM42605 sensor in Zephyr RTOS environment.

methods.name: now_str
methods.description: Returns a formatted string of the current uptime in HH:MM:SS.MMM format.

methods.name: process_icm42605
methods.description: Fetches sensor data (temperature, accelerometer, gyroscope) and prints it.

methods.name: handle_icm42605_drdy
methods.description: Handles data ready trigger, processes sensor data, and cancels trigger on failure.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Initializes sensor device, sets up triggers for tap, double tap, and data ready events, and configures sampling.
